description: A GotoTask loop condition: Activity-owned Expression (not ProcessDef-owned). The Boolean literal false() is a ZERO-ARG Function node, never a Static — a Static "false" would be a string and never match a Boolean field.
notes: The literal leaf (Node_Sample03) omits BOTH Syntax and Node::Node — those only appear on the infix root. A zero-arg Function is a pure leaf, structurally different from the Field/Static leaves used for a string comparison (see expression_branch.json).

Category is set from the OPERANDS (Boolean here, since both sides are Boolean), never copied from DataType (DataType is always "Boolean" — the comparison's result type — regardless of what is being compared).

An Expression's owner key is one of three, meaning three different things: ProcessDef = branch condition, Activity = goto loop condition (this shape), Property = SequenceNumber prefix (see field_sequence_number.json). Always branch on which key is present.
A bare GotoTask with NO Activity::Expression loops forever — the condition is what lets an item eventually escape the loop.
Gate polarity: always test a Boolean, never an optional Select — see field_boolean.json's notes for why an unticked Boolean fails closed while a blank Select fails open.
